property_summary: For any target that reverts on receiving ETH, sending money via sendMoney should itself revert (reference: sendMoney reverts when the low-level call fails); the mutant inverts that check and instead reverts when the low-level call succeeds, so it will NOT revert for failing callees but will revert for successful ones — breaking the rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Invert the success check so that the call reverts when the low-level call SUCCEEDS, causing sendMoney to revert on successful transfers instead of on failures.
